title: Department of Veterans Affairs: VA FISMA Audit: Fiscal Year 2022
publisher: Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Inspector General
summary: The annual independent audit evaluates VA's information-security program against the FY 2022 federal metrics. Phase 56E entity use: The three annual audits and the later GAO inventory preserve continuing oversight work without turning unlike recommendation scopes into a performance trend.
key_findings: The record establishes an agency-wide oversight baseline and identifies continuing control weaknesses and corrective actions.
Entity layer: VA agency information-security program.
Compatibility boundary: Same agency and control domain; the annual audits and GAO inventory use different scopes and must remain separate.
why_it_matters: The record supports one or more layers of the second-cohort panel, driver-and-constraint dossier, and alternative-explanation test.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves a stable second-cohort entity identity.
Keeps attribution and the observation denominator visible.
Connects the same entity vertically across three evidence layers.
evidence_limits: An annual program audit does not measure identical systems, incidents, mission effects, or control populations in later years.
Independent official oversight; no closure or effectiveness is inferred from a recommendation count.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
